title: Arrival
synopsis: Twelve ships, a linguist who dreams about a daughter, and a language that rearranges what time means.

nodes.text: A class emptied of students, a phone vibrating in a coat.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Go to the door” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You marry Ian on a quiet day and you have the daughter who will not stay long, and you love her exactly enough.
The world's leaders speak to each other through circles of ink and the war that almost started becomes the peace that almost surprised them.
You teach a course at the university about a language that nobody else can quite read. Students drift in and out. One stays. One always stays.
